title: Scaling All-to-All Operations Across Emerging Many-Core Supercomputers
problem: Existing all-to-all MPI algorithms don't fully exploit many-core supercomputer architectures; performance varies with message size and process count
motivation: Develop all-to-all algorithms optimized for emerging many-core systems to accelerate FFT, transposition, and ML applications
method: Novel all-to-all algorithms designed for many-core supercomputers with optimization for message size and process count variations
key_novelty: 3x speedup over system MPI on Sapphire Rapids at 32 nodes; algorithms tailored to many-core architecture characteristics
contributions: Novel all-to-all algorithms for many-core supercomputers
3x speedup demonstration on Sapphire Rapids systems
limitations: Limited to Sapphire Rapids; scalability beyond 32 nodes not discussed; specific message size ranges not detailed
primary_theme: Optimized collective operations for many-core systems
